name: VCP Octree Construction
definition: A hierarchical octree structure built bottom-up from a VCP grid to store VCP information only in the close vicinity of the surface, lowering memory requirements while ensuring no intersection is lost.
summary: VCP Octree Construction builds a hierarchical octree from a VCP grid to store surface data only near the geometry, using bottom-up merging and dynamic subvolume loading to reduce memory usage while maintaining intersection accuracy.
